title.narrative: Capacity Building for Public Sector Auditing

description.narrative: " The objective of the Grant is to improve the operational capacity of the Armenian public sector external audit through design of the detailed capacity building strategy and action plan and development of the audit methods. While Armenia has undertaken many positive steps to improve the public sector external auditcomma including enhancing the authority and independence of the Armenian Supreme Audit Institution (SAI) in 2005comma major capacity constraints are currently exist. The Armenian SAI lacks capacity to implement professional audits; instead mainly ""soviet style"" inspection function is exercisedcomma which is confirmed by several diagnostics. The objective of the IDF grant is to focus on supporting the Armenian Chamber of Control (COC) - Armenian SAI - in (1) assessment of the present capacity and constraintscomma (2) development of the capacity building action plan; and (3) development/adoption of the appropriate audit standards and methods with limited training provided. The development objective would also imply supporting Armenian SAI working with integrity and meeting the professional standards. As a result of the grant implementation the SAI has to organize and manage its own operations and activities in ways which equal or surpass the standards that SAIs expect the organizations (including government and donor funded projects) they audit to achieve. The grant will be built on the government's commitment to reform the SAIcomma which will help to strengthen the accountabilitycomma transparency and efficiency in the reporting and use of public funds. Particularlycomma the grant will first support detailed assessment of the COC to identify all the capacity gaps and existing constrainscomma and then support the development of the capacity building detailed time bound action plan. As a first key element of the SAI strategy implementationcomma the grant will support the development and adoption of the audit standards and methods in line with International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions (INTOSAI) standards. In additioncomma an audit manual for tailored audit of Bank financed operations will be developed and relevant unit staff be trained. The activities to be covered by the grant are the key priority actions recommended by the INTOSAI Guidelines on Building Capacity in the SAIs. That is particularly in line with the Memorandum of Understanding signed between INTOSAI and donor community (including the WB) launching a new global strategic initiative on capacity development of SAIs in aid recipient countries. The grant proposal covers only priority actions of the government request. Considering the limitation of the timeline and budget of IDF grantcomma the other key activities reflected in the government request may be considered for future applicationcomma if the activities covered in this proposal are successfully implemented.
